hero.title:
We don't build for awards.
*We build to reduce darkness.*
hero.subtitle: From a small idea in Onitsha to national and international platforms, OneGrid Energies has been recognised by organisations, competitions, institutions and communities for our work in clean energy, circular innovation and community impact.

philosophy.title: We Don't Build for Awards
philosophy.closing: While we are here, we can reduce darkness.

paragraphs.text: Every recognition is an honour, but it is not the reason we started.
We started because we saw darkness.

Darkness in homes without reliable electricity. Darkness created by waste that was treated as worthless. Darkness that limited children's ability to study, families' ability to work, and communities' ability to thrive.

The awards are reminders that the work matters. But the real measure of our success is not the number of trophies on our shelf. It is the number of lives that experience more light because we chose to build.

cta.title: The Recognition Is Only the Beginning
cta.text: We are continuing to build practical clean-energy solutions that expand access to electricity, transform waste into useful products and create opportunities for the people and communities we serve.
